command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$probe=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("hc-settings-card-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID+".py")
@'
import subprocess,time
from pywinauto import Desktop
def until(fn,label,seconds=20):
    end=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(label)
for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows():
    if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings"):
        try:x.close()
        except Exception:pass
time.sleep(1)
subprocess.Popen(["cmd","/c","start","","ms-settings:"])
win=until(lambda:(lambda ws:ws[-1] if ws else None)([x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows() if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings")]),"Settings missing")
acc=until(lambda:next((e for e in win.descendants(control_type="ListItem") if (e.window_text() or "").strip() in ("접근성","Accessibility")),None),"Accessibility nav missing")
acc.click_input();time.sleep(2)
matches=[]
for e in win.descendants():
    info=e.element_info;name=(info.name or "").strip()
    if name in ("대비 테마","Contrast themes"):
        matches.append((info.control_type,name,info.automation_id))
print("CONTRAST_MATCHES",matches,flush=True)
for e in win.descendants():
    info=e.element_info;name=(info.name or "").strip()
    if ("대비" in name or "contrast" in name.lower()) and info.control_type in ("Button","Group","ListItem","Text"):
        print("CONTRAST_CANDIDATE",info.control_type,repr(name),repr(info.automation_id),flush=True)
try:win.close()
except Exception:pass
print("HIGH_CONTRAST_SETTINGS_CARD_PROBE_PASS",flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $probe -Encoding UTF8
& python -X utf8 $probe
$code=$LASTEXITCODE
Remove-Item $probe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if($code -ne 0){throw "Settings contrast card probe failed"}
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_SETTINGS_CARD_CONTROL_PASS"
